title: Chapter 3 Grouped Dwellings

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf
source.extract: Working/text/draft/Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.txt

notes: Twin of Chapter 2. Rules identical to Chapter 2 keep the same clause ID under /ch3/ and the pairing lint holds them together; divergences carry notes beginning 'diverges:'. R80 standards apply to grouped dwellings in R100, R160, LR, MR and HR (Table 3A footnote). Grouped-only matters: communal streets and common property, visitor parking (C2.3.3, C2.3.7), internal site boundaries (C3.4.6), communal street width and passing bays (C3.7.5, C3.7.6, C3.7.13 to C3.7.15), pedestrian access (C3.7.10 to C3.7.12), universal design 20% of dwellings (C2.7.1), landscaping plan (C1.2.8), shade trees (C1.2.5), site area per dwelling (Table 3B).
